rule: GOAL: Align your cross so its arms pass through all four yellow dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cross center; spacebar confirms the solution. RULE: The cross’s horizontal and vertical lines must simultaneously intersect every target dot. TRAP: Assuming the cross stays fully on-screen; it can extend off-board to reach higher dots.

GOAL: Move the player to the exit within the action limit. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player one tile at a time. RULE: You cannot pass through walls or blocked tiles. TRAP: Assuming the player slides until hitting a wall wastes moves; steps are discrete.

GOAL: Align the yellow block with the gap in the wall to clear the level. CONTROLS: Clicking the top blue block shifts the player right; clicking the bottom blue block shifts the player left. RULE: Each click moves the player exactly four columns horizontally, changing the block's alignment relative to the fixed gap. TRAP: Assuming the player could move vertically or that the gap moved; the solution required precise horizontal counting to reach negative offsets.

GOAL: Guide the purple token along the diagonal rail to touch the gray core inside the distant blue blob. CONTROLS: Click empty grid cells to move the token up to six spaces toward that spot; clicking too far fails. RULE: The token must physically overlap the blob’s center to win, not just reach the rail’s end. TRAP: Believing you could jump the full distance in one click; moves are capped at six spaces, requiring multiple steps.

GOAL: Position the catch bar to funnel liquid into both cup notches. CONTROLS: Arrows move the bar horizontally; Space runs the pouring simulation. RULE: The spray width equals the bar width plus four columns on each side, so center the bar between the cups. TRAP: Assuming placing the bar directly under the drop catches the liquid, when it actually passes through unless aligned with the cup openings.

GOAL: Move three shapes to matching outlines using twenty-one moves and two selections. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the selected shape three steps; spacebar cycles focus among all shapes. RULE: Shapes overlap freely, so ignore collisions and focus purely on aligning centers with the dotted targets. TRAP: Assuming the cursor order stays fixed wastes time; always verify which shape is active after moving others.

GOAL: Align the moving boundary to clear the path. CONTROLS: Click buttons to expand or shrink the wall segments. RULE: Each wall has independent controls; one wall might be a decoy. TRAP: Assuming all buttons affect the active barrier; some walls have no effect until unlocked.

GOAL: Reach the exit while navigating past a stationary guard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step per press. RULE: The guard only lunges horizontally along its facing row, leaving vertical approaches safe. TRAP: Assuming the guard attacks from any adjacent direction causes fatal errors; vertical adjacency is safe.

GOAL: Place three separate boxes into three distinct empty slots. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate and move the player; Space picks up or drops the held item. RULE: The player must stand directly adjacent to a box to grab it, then move to the target slot to release it. TRAP: Believing you can push boxes directly into place; you must carry them by standing on their previous location.

GOAL: Cover all scattered dots using three objects. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active object; Space switches to the next object. RULE: Each object must land on at least one dot to complete the level. TRAP: Thinking Space costs significant time; it is instant, so prioritize precise movement over speed.

GOAL: Match each column’s glyph to its correct partner based on the blue reference pair. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor between columns; Up/Down arrows cycle through the available glyphs in the current column. RULE: A column is solved only when its selected glyph is the true partner of the blue pair, regardless of rotation. TRAP: Assuming the initial glyph was correct or that rotation mattered, leading to wasted cycles searching for non-existent rotated matches.

GOAL: Align three colored caps simultaneously within a strict timer. CONTROLS: Clicking a segment shifts adjacent timer values up or down by two. RULE: Caps only lock when all targets hit their exact numbers at the same time. TRAP: Assuming you could fix caps one by one; early alignment wastes the timer on unsolved caps.

GOAL: Route the glowing plug into the matching socket to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Click the plug to shift it right; click again to drop it down. RULE: The plug moves exactly one grid unit per click, following the cord’s visible path. TRAP: Believing the plug stays stationary after the first move; it continues sliding until it hits an obstacle or target.

GOAL: Navigate a grid to the exit while eliminating three stationary guards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one cell; entering a guard cell removes it. RULE: Guards are only destroyed when approached from a side perpendicular to their facing direction. TRAP: Assuming any entry kills a guard fails; approaching from the front or back leaves you vulnerable.

GOAL: Slide two separate 2x2 blocks until they touch, then merge them into a single shape. CONTROLS: Click a grid cell to instantly move the nearest block so its corner lands there. RULE: Blocks only combine when their edges are directly adjacent; distance does not matter, only contact. TRAP: Assuming you must push blocks toward a specific target zone first; they merge wherever they meet.

GOAL: Assign shapes to fill matching color regions efficiently. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor and shape position. Space places or locks the current shape. RULE: Touching a fill area with any part of the shape instantly recolors the entire shape. TRAP: Moving the center directly into the fill is unnecessary; arm contact at a distance triggers the effect.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking the four plus-cells shrinks the blue tip to a 2x2 mini-tip. The mini-tip can slide horizontally toward the right edge. FAILED: Clicking cells in various orders, pressing directional keys to rotate or move the full tip, and moving the mini-tip to the far right edge without inserting it. GOAL IS NOT: Simply shrinking the tip, rotating the tip to face specific directions, or reaching the absolute rightmost column. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the blue half to face that direction; pressing again moves the tip. Mouse clicks activate keypad cells.

ESTABLISHED: The block moves six rows vertically and the tip shifts six columns horizontally. Targets are pushed only when the arm sweeps through their exact 2x2 footprint. FAILED: Attempting to trigger the win condition by simply connecting all three targets simultaneously regardless of their column positions. GOAL IS NOT: A state where targets are merely connected to the arm in any random arrangement against the wall. CONTROLS: Up and Down shift the entire block vertically. Left and Right extend or retract the arm tip.

GOAL: Merge scattered dots into a single Y, then move it to the target blob. CONTROLS: Drag any dot to slide it; dots merge if they land close enough. RULE: You can only move one dot at a time; merging requires precise alignment. TRAP: Thinking you can move multiple dots simultaneously or that distance doesn't matter for merging.

GOAL: Arrange colored tokens in the middle slots to match the color sequence displayed at the top of the screen. CONTROLS: Click a token in the bottom palette to select it, then click a middle slot to place it. Press space to confirm the solution. RULE: The top row defines the required left-to-right order; the bottom row is simply a shuffled inventory of available pieces. TRAP: Assuming the bottom tokens could be placed in their visual order, ignoring the specific sequence mandated by the top legend.
